children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may test support at 4,788 ringgit per metric ton, driven by a wave c.
A projection analysis reveals that this wave has travelled far below its 61.8% projection level of 4,876 rniggit. It is highly likely to extend to 4,788 ringgit, the 100% level.
Immediate resistance is at 4,843 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain to 4,876 ringgit. On the daily chart, a channel technique indicates a target of 4,680 ringgit.
The market is likely to reach this target, as the pattern from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit looks like a double-top, which will be confirmed when the contract breaks support at 4,814 ringgit.
The pattern suggests a lower target of 4,597 ringgit.
